description: The legacy `Aspire.RabbitMQ.Client.v6` and `Aspire.MongoDB.Driver.v2` integration packages are removed from the repository and will no longer be published. Consumers should migrate to `Aspire.RabbitMQ.Client` (RabbitMQ.Client 7.x) and `Aspire.MongoDB.Driver` (MongoDB.Driver 3.x); previously published versions remain available on NuGet.
name: Removed legacy RabbitMQ.Client v6 and MongoDB.Driver v2 packages
